name: The absolute refractive index of any material medium is always:
description:
Question:

The absolute refractive index of any material medium is always:

(a) Greater than 1
(b) Less than 1
(c) Equal to 1
(d) Zero

Answer: (a) Greater than 1 ✅

Formula:

μ = c/v

Where,

μ = Absolute Refractive Index
c = Speed of light in vacuum = 3 × 10⁸ m/s
v = Speed of light in medium

Concept:

Since light travels fastest in vacuum,

c > v

Therefore,

μ = c/v > 1

Hence,

Absolute Refractive Index is always greater than 1.

Special Case:

Vacuum:
μ = 1

Any Material Medium:
μ > 1

TRICK:

"Vacuum mein One,
Medium mein More than One."

Yaad Rakho:

c > v
⇒ c/v > 1
⇒ μ > 1

One-Line Exam Trick:

"Absolute Refractive Index = c/v

Vacuum fastest hai,
isliye μ hamesha 1 se bada hota hai."
